decisions.reason: The fourth rotary axis accessory extends the firm's established milling machines at low cost and supports sales of the core systems.

Hybrid additive post-processing is distant from the core offer and was only mentioned on the website, so it is the riskiest product, but it fits the firm's strategic direction toward future-oriented materials processing and is worth continuing for now.
The high-speed CNC milling line sits at the heart of the firm's competence, has several models and its own web page, and serves a growing industry.
The automatic tool change system adds automation value to the core machines, has its own web page and builds on established know-how.
